sentences.text: Ajibur Rahaman vs Unknown on 14 August, 2024

Author: Soumen Sen Bench: Soumen Sen 14.08.2024  SL No.36 Court No.29  (gc)
 (Rejected)
 CRM (A) 2754 of 2024

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under section 438 of  the Code of Criminal Procedure corresponding to Section 482 of  the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in  connection with Lalgola Police Station Case No.264 of 2024 dated  09.04.2024 under Sections 376/506 of the Indian Penal Code.
And  In the matter of : Ajibur Rahaman  - Petitioner.

Mr. Soumik Ganguly,
 Ms. Ratna Ghosh  ... For the State.

1.
In spite of service, the victim is not represented.

2. The learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been falsely implicated and husband of the complainant took some financial assistance from the present petitioner in cash and since the petitioner had demanded repayment of such amount, a false complaint has been lodged against the petitioner.
3. The learned Counsel for the State in opposing the prayer for anticipatory bail has produced the case diary.

4. Considering the materials available in the case diary, the statement of the victim directly implicating the petitioner in the commission of the alleged offence and the statement of the neighbours of the petitioner recorded under Section 161 of the Cr.P.C. which, prima facie,
corroborates the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C. directly implicating the petitioner in the commission of the alleged offence, we are not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
